headline: ARC-3 gold line rises as two teams slip out

sections.text: The ARC-3 gold cutoff rose 0.80 in the past day to 37.98. mikelou1 fell from 17th to 19th and Tom. from 18th to 20th, leaving both outside the 18 gold places.
mikelou1 is now first outside gold at 37.27, 0.71 short of the cutoff, as the medal-place bar continues to climb.
